title: Privacy Policy | NovoTech Machine Tools
meta_description: How NovoTech Machine Tools collects, uses and protects the information you send through this website, including quote requests, attachments and the AI machine finder.
intro: This policy explains what information NovoTech Machine Tools Inc. collects through novotechmachinetools.com, why we collect it and how we protect it. It applies to this website only.

sections.title: Who we are
text: NovoTech Machine Tools Inc., 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON L5T 2J5, Canada. Questions about this policy or your information can be sent to info@NovoTechMachineTools.com or by phone to +1 647 526 5510.

sections.title: Information you send us
text: When you send the quote form, we receive your name, email address and the optional company name, phone number, machine of interest, message and any files you attach (drawings, photos or documents). The form is delivered to our sales inbox by email.
When you call, email or message us on social media, we receive the information you choose to share.

sections.title: How we use it
text: We use your information to answer your request: to recommend machines, send quotations and brochures, arrange delivery, installation, training, service and warranty work, and to keep a record of our business with you. We do not sell or rent your information, and we do not add you to a mailing list without your consent.

sections.title: Spam protection
text: The quote form is protected by Google reCAPTCHA. reCAPTCHA collects hardware and software information, such as device and application data, and sends it to Google to check that the form is sent by a person. Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply to that check.

sections.title: AI machine finder
text: The AI machine finder sends the question you type, together with our machine catalogue, to Anthropic's Claude service to write the answer. Do not type personal information into it. The questions are not used to identify you; to protect the service from abuse, the server keeps a short-lived count of requests per IP address.

sections.title: Videos and other services
text: Product videos are embedded from YouTube in its privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com). A video loads when it comes into view or when you press play, and YouTube's privacy policy then applies. Links to our pages on YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok take you to those services, whose own privacy policies apply.

sections.title: Cookies
text: This website sets no cookies of its own and uses no advertising or analytics trackers. Google reCAPTCHA and YouTube, described above, may set their own cookies when they load.

sections.title: How long we keep it and how we protect it
text: We keep enquiries and quotations for as long as we need them to serve you and to meet our legal and accounting obligations, and then delete them. The website is served over HTTPS, and access to our email and records is limited to the NovoTech staff who need it.

sections.title: Your rights
text: Under Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) you can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or withdraw your consent and ask us to delete it, subject to our legal obligations. Write to info@NovoTechMachineTools.com and we will reply within 30 days.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
text: We will post any change to this policy on this page with a new effective date.
